data.name: Gangadutt
data.gender_notes: Gangadutt is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gangadutt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ganga' meaning river and 'Dutt' meaning son. This name signifies the son of Goddess Ganga, who is revered in Hinduism. It is a popular name in Hindu communities and holds significant cultural and spiritual significance. The name Gangadutt carries the meaning “Goddess Ganga's son” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gangadutt usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess ganga's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine connection with the Goddess Ganga and the flow of her blessings.
